title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 52 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 52)

content.overview: Section 52 provides that Chapter II of Part II does not apply in relation to foreign awards to which Chapter I applies.

content.study:
Section 52 — Chapter II not to apply

Section 52 provides that Chapter II of Part II does not apply in relation to foreign awards to which Chapter I applies.

Apply the provision within Chapter II of Part II and identify the precise Convention framework, statutory condition and enforcement consequence. Do not treat enforcement as a merits appeal.
